cohort: 44 pregnant women with platelet count less than 150,000/cumm attending an antenatal clinic at NRI Medical College and General Hospital, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India
finding: The incidence of thrombocytopaenia was 10%, with the most common causes being gestational thrombocytopaenia (38.6%), preeclampsia (18.18%), and gestational hypertension (9.09%), and maternal complications included ICU admission (11.36%), MODS (6.81%), hysterectomy (4.54%), PPH (4.54%), wound infection (4.54%), laparotomy (2.27%), and mortality (2 cases).
